2609.21334.title: Co-Evolving Zero-Day Jamming: Adaptive Attack Synthesis and Graph Attention-Based Online Detection
2609.21334.paper_summary: Effective evaluation of zero-day jamming detectors requires robust adversarial models. However, existing attack models often assume prior knowledge of the target receiver, limiting their utility as evaluation benchmarks. On the detection side, existing detectors fail to capture the global temporal-spectral structure of jamming behavior and cannot differentiate zero-day strategies as they emerge. This paper addresses these limitations through a two-pronged framework. First, an online detection framework is introduced that combines a graph attention network (GAT) for temporal-spectral representation learning with Dirichlet process (DP)-means clustering. This framework jointly classifies known and discovers zero-day strategies within a unified learning objective. Second, an inference-driven reinforcement learning (RL) jammer is proposed as an adversarial benchmark. The jammer treats the target receiver as a black-box, infers the detector state via hypothesis testing, and optimizes the trade-off between attack impact and stealth. Simulation results show that the proposed RL jammer outperforms benchmarks, achieving 33% higher attack efficacy and 67% higher stealth. The proposed detection framework against the proposed RL jammer is shown to achieve 20% higher detection accuracy than the benchmarks.
2609.21334.paper_summary_zh: 有效的零日干擾檢測器評估需要穩健的對抗模型。<lb/>然而，現有的攻擊模型通常假設對目標接收器有先前的了解，這限制了它們作為評估基準的效用。<lb/>在檢測方面，現有的檢測器未能捕捉到干擾行為的全球時間-頻譜結構，並且無法區分隨著時間出現的零日策略。<lb/>本文通過一個雙管齊下的框架來解決這些限制。<lb/>首先，介紹了一個在線檢測框架，該框架結合了圖注意力網絡（GAT）用於時間-頻譜表示學習和狄利克雷過程（DP）均值聚類。<lb/>該框架在統一的學習目標下共同分類已知和發現的零日策略。<lb/>其次，提出了一種基於推理驅動的強化學習（RL）干擾器作為對抗基準。<lb/>該干擾器將目標接收器視為黑箱，通過假設檢驗推斷檢測器狀態，並優化攻擊影響和隱蔽性之間的權衡。<lb/>模擬結果顯示，所提出的RL干擾器在攻擊效能上比基準高出33%，在隱蔽性上高出67%。<lb/>針對所提出的RL干擾器的檢測框架顯示其檢測準確率比基準高出20%。
